en: Hello, I'm the captain of the Nightstar Watch.
What? The Watch report?
Oh no! I completely forgot about it...
I'll take it over right now!
When you're feeling down, it's best to get out for a walk.
Thanks for the reminder, or I'd have been dead meat...
I've got nothing to repay you with... Tell you what, I'll teach you this.
Come visit Nightstar again sometime.
Huh? What's going on? It's pitch black. Light a torch, quick.
Lighting it...
No way!! Even a torch won't light it up? What's going on?
Even a torch won't light it...? This is... um...
Ah! I remember! This is the "Eternal Darkness"!
So what do we do?
Well... I remember reading about it in some book...
That... that one...
Right! We go back to Kabras and look it up in the Royal Library.
K-Kabras? That's so far...
It's no big deal. Come on, let's go.
(It's only no big deal for you...)
Okay, let's try this stone...
It worked! Let's get moving.
That's the set! Let's hurry and find that old geezer!

Do I really exist? What a headache of a question. Someone once said "I think, therefore I am", but I don't think that's quite enough. Is there really such a person as me in this world? Or, to put it another way...
The stone at the city's highest point has been there since long, long ago. No one knows where it came from.
So you aren't the first to reach me. Then we shall do this the usual way.
Very good...
Haaah...
Got anything you don't need? Sell it to me.
Best not to take too much medicine, you know.
Sleep... sleep... sleep...
HEY! Have you come to learn from me?
GOOD! So what do you want to learn?
Thunderclap
Dazzle
OK! Watch me.
OH! You've learned everything I know.
Something this easy, you don't need me to teach it twice, right?
If not, I'm going back to sleep.
I've got something really handy here. Pay me 5000 Gold and it's yours.
You haven't even got the money, and you want to buy things?
My necklace is gone, and I can't find it anywhere...
Ah, yes, that's it! Did you find it for me? Thank you so much!
Here, I made this myself. It's for you!
Who are you!!
What are you doing here!
Eluna hands over a sheet of paper.
Ah! A letter from Lord Reiter. All right! Go on in!
Wait, we want to know...
...On the morning of the 20th we completed our evacuation from Kabras. Over 16,000 dead. Over 7,300 survivors.
The Forgotten City's steward shows them records accurate to the day.
Thank you... Oh, and I was wondering...

You need somewhere to stay the night, right? We get no travelers here, so there's no inn. Hmm, let me think... You can stay right here. The office isn't exactly luxurious, but I think you'll find it comfortable enough.
Th-thank you, that's very kind.
Next morning, outside Delat's door.
Delat, why don't we go out and look around? This city's actually pretty nice...
Sightsee? At that rate we'll see the Cross Entry in our next life.
The door opens. Delat looks a little tired, but he's smiling.
Let's go get the last key. I don't want to waste any more time.
Come on, let's go. I'm not as fragile as you think.
O-okay...
Hurry up! I'm going to make him tell me everything!
Maze Mk II
Same to same
Persistence is victory
Got 5000 Gold.
Ha ha, someone has finally come! Come, take my challenge!
Ha, that's the last one. Eluna, your wish is about to come true.
Another huge figure suddenly appears.
So you've finally made it, fools seeking the surface?
Who are you?
You don't need to know that. Come on, show me what you've got.
Ha ha, so I finally lost...
The huge monster turns into a small child.
You... how can...
I told you, you don't need to know. But I'll tell you a little something: the surface isn't as pretty as you think~~ There isn't a single person up there.
Not a single person? Explain yourself properly! Then what about my parents?!!
Eluna grabs the child and shakes him over and over.
Your parents? Ha ha, I never imagined anyone could survive up there.
Why?! Why is it like this?!!
Haaah... Now I'm dying too... and two thousand years late, at that...
The child doesn't answer her. He falls, then vanishes.
No! I'm going to find that historian. He owes me a full answer!!
We're almost there, right?
Probably. I've never been here either.
Okay, then let's speed it up!
Faster again...
Kid, looks like you're from the palace, huh?
The man ahead is in his forties, clad in armor, and looks very tired.
I'm a girl, and I'm not from the palace.
He obviously didn't mean you!
Delat pulls Eluna back and looks at the man.
How do you know I'm from the palace?
Heh heh, all the better. Come here and die!
Just what kind of guy are you?
The "kind of guy" doesn't answer. His face says 'I lost, so kill me.'
Then sulk there all you like. We've got places to be.
You're not going to kill me?
No time.
He freezes for a moment, then turns and leaves.
Hey! Wait, you kind-of-guy, you dropped something!
He's already gone... Who was that? He even runs away fast... Should we go after him?
No. Getting to Snowblade is more important. If he wants it back, he'll come find us.
Then... how about a rest?
No! Move it, now!
Waaah!!! Let go of me! That hurts...
You two thieves!! Give me back my ring!
I knew it was too good to be true...
Huh? This time he didn't just lose, he passed out too?
Is this really Leoz?
So what now? His head should fetch a pretty good bounty, right?
Wake him up first. I want to know why we beat him so easily.
Ugh...
You're awake?
Ah! Damn you! My...
Something arcs through the air and lands right in Leoz's hand.
Your ring.
Wait, Eluna, didn't we already give that to the St. Melo Keep office?
That one was a fake~ How could I hand something this important to them!
Good grief...
Mister, why were you alone last time? And why did you lose to us so easily?
We were ambushed by the army. I'm the only one who survived.
So you were wounded. Then why attack us? And why do you hate the King so much? As rulers go, he's not bad.
Because... that throne was mine!!
Y-you mean my father stole your throne?
That's right. He's my younger brother. I was the one who should have inherited the throne.
But I've never even heard of an uncle like you!
Of course not. He didn't just steal my throne, he drove all of Kabras's original citizens out too.
Why would he do that?
He led the army and killed my mother, who was ruling at the time. He replaced all the old ministers, then tried to kill me too, but I escaped.
Oh... Back then Kabras didn't have many citizens and no army was stationed there, so it didn't much matter. But if word reached the other cities, his throne would be in danger.

Exactly! He drove the original citizens out of the city and branded them rebels, so the story was safe to spread. And I was made out to be the rebels' leader, who murdered his own mother for the throne.
So he must have cracked down on those citizens, and that's why they formed the Moon of Vengeance?
Hmph! Who wants to leave their own home! He killed all those people for his own gain. That bastard!!
Wait. You've said a lot, but why should we believe you?! You're the leader of the Moon of Vengeance. To save your skin, you'd make up anything.
Hmph! Believe it or don't, that's your business. I lost anyway. If you want to kill me, kill me!
Delat, he's your uncle! Be polite!
Mister, one more question. Why are you alone again this time?
Our headquarters was raided.
So a lot more people were killed... Can you walk on your own now?
I can.
Then, Delat, let's go.
Where?
To ask that former Historian. If what Leoz says is true, Reiter was still an official in Kabras when the Moon of Vengeance was founded.
He led the army and killed my mother, who was ruling at the time. He replaced all the old ministers, then tried to kill me too, but I escaped.
Want to get past? You'll have to beat me first!
Where's the one for this city?
Let me see... Huh? It's right outside the city.
That easy? Great, let's hurry.
Ah, there's a door here!
Delat puts the key in the door.
Don't open... don't open...
The door opens.
You have no key.
Something feels wrong! Let's go take a look, quick!
This is...
The Moon of Vengeance has stormed Kabras...
Leoz?
You two...
Nice blitz. Take Kabras fast, before the reinforcements arrive. And you've wrecked the teleport circles too, I take it?
...That's right...
Right now, we want to get into the palace.
The palace? The doors have been sealed from the inside.
Then we'll go in through the sewers.
So this is the Cross Entry?
Ugh! It won't open!
Wait, look to the side. There are some pillars.
Come. Defeat me, and you will see the final truth.
So it really is like this...
A gray sky, blood-red ground, and no sign of life anywhere.
Yes. This is the true surface.
I am the last Guardian, the one you have just defeated.
And not only me. All the ones you defeated before, the ones guarding the keys, were 'people'.
It was a little over two thousand years ago. Back then, humans all lived on the beautiful surface.
How I miss them... those pretty little grasses.
Then lightstone was discovered, and it soon became the main source of energy.
How to get the most out of it became humanity's great field of research, and they succeeded: the ultimate refinement of lightstone, Sunstone, was extracted.
The stone on your wrist is Sunstone. It does not glow, but it holds tremendous power.
Then, for some reason, all-out war broke out among humans, and Sunstone became a weapon of that war.
We, too, were remade into powerful 'weapons' with Sunstone.
You must have met the one with the huge black wings? He was the youngest of us.
When his own little sister was to be remade too, in a fit of rage he destroyed the largest Sunstone reserve.
The energy that leaked out utterly destroyed the surface, and humanity did not escape it.
Before the energy could spread, the few of us carried the survivors underground.
We became the guardians of the exit to the surface, and left only the bracelet on your wrist as the one and only key.
We have waited over two thousand years, until you came.
...So that's how it is? So I really am just an ordinary orphan? And this bracelet only came to me by chance?
If this world isn't the one I imagined, then I'll just have to make it that way with my own hands!!
Eluna smiles and firmly wipes away her tears.
Year 6 of the Cross Era.
Only you could come up with this, huh? Turning the whole surface over and planting it all again...
I thought of it the moment I saw this ground: what if only the top layer was poisoned? I just never expected it to be such a thin layer.
I don't get it. You say a few words and all of Okaros comes up here to do hard labor with you. But... why do I have to be the one babysitting?!
With stamina as bad as yours, you want to plant trees? Hey~~ Don't tell me you don't like these kids?
N-no, that's not it.
Delat dodges a little hand jabbing at his eye as he speaks.
Uncle Leoz's little princes are so cute. How could anyone not like them?
Delat carefully pries off a little hand that's pinching his ear hard.
It's just... when are we going to have a few of our own?
You mean getting married? That can wait until I've fixed the surface.
Ah, but we'll both be old by then...
Then you can go find someone else.
Whoa! Really, I can?
You can try. =_=!
